title: Tamil Nadu Government ITI trade training (DET)
description: Trade training at Industrial Training Institutes run by the Directorate of Employment and Training, Tamil Nadu. Admission is online and based on marks in the qualifying exam. Trades, required class and dates vary by year and trade, so check the official prospectus.
eligibility_requirements: Completed or appeared for the class required for the trade in the prospectus
Admission is on merit; there is no entrance exam
source_name: Directorate of Employment and Training, Tamil Nadu

title: DDU-GKY skill training and placement for rural youth
description: Placement-linked skill training for rural poor youth under a Ministry of Rural Development scheme. Courses and training centres vary by place and time, so check the scheme portal.
eligibility_requirements: Youth from families below the poverty line
source_name: Tamil Nadu Corporation for Development of Women (DDU-GKY page)

title: RSETI self-employment training for rural youth
description: Self-employment training at Rural Self Employment Training Institutes, which banks run with the Ministry of Rural Development, to help unemployed youth start self-employment or find wage work. Hand-holding support is given after training.
eligibility_requirements: Unemployed youth aged 18 to 45 with an aptitude for self-employment or wage employment
source_name: Tamil Nadu Corporation for Development of Women (RSETI page)

title: NAPS-2 apprenticeship with employer stipend support
description: Apprenticeship with an employer under the Apprentices Act, 1961. Under NAPS-2 the Government of India shares 25% of the stipend with the employer, up to Rs. 1,500 per month per apprentice. Apprentices and employers register on the Apprenticeship India portal.
eligibility_requirements: Minimum age 14; 18 for trades in hazardous industries
Must meet the minimum education and physical standard set for the trade
source_name: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship (NAPS-2)

title: Pudhumai Penn: Rs. 1,000 a month for girls in higher education
description: Moovalur Ramamirtham Ammaiyar Higher Education Assurance Scheme of the Tamil Nadu Social Welfare and Women Empowerment Department. Girls from government schools get Rs. 1,000 a month while they study a higher education course. Applications are made on the Pen Kalvi portal.
eligibility_requirements: Girl students who studied Classes 6 to 12 in Tamil Nadu government schools, then joined higher education after Class 10 or Class 12
Admitted to a recognised institution in Tamil Nadu, including ITI, diploma or higher education courses
Documents required are listed on the Pen Kalvi portal; keep the school study certificate, bank passbook and admission proof ready
source_name: Social Welfare and Women Empowerment Department, Tamil Nadu (Pen Kalvi portal)

title: Tamil Pudhalvan: Rs. 1,000 a month for boys in higher education
description: Tamil Nadu scheme, on the lines of Pudhumai Penn, that gives boys from government schools Rs. 1,000 a month while they study a degree, diploma, ITI or equivalent course. Students apply online through UMIS after joining the course.
eligibility_requirements: Male students who studied Classes 6 to 12 in government schools
Boys from government-aided schools qualify if they studied in Tamil medium from Classes 6 to 12
Studying a degree, diploma, ITI or equivalent course at a recognised institution in Tamil Nadu
Needs school study certificate, bank passbook, Aadhaar and admission proof
source_name: Government of Tamil Nadu (scheme page on tils.tn.gov.in)
